analysis: The only change in this PR is one added line in .github/workflows/ci.yml (head line 67). It adds `python3 scripts/test-provider-cluster-runtime-models.py` to the Release Integrity job's "Check provider release and installer integrity" step. The job runs on the routed read-only lane, and the workflow has `permissions: contents: read`. The change adds no new secrets, triggers, third-party actions, permissions or network steps, and it does not touch artifact publishing, signing, attestation or coordinator code. I found no effect on the assets or boundaries in the threat model (A-001 through A-019, TB-002/003/007/009/011/012/013, T-041 and others). It is a test-only addition, so it adds CI coverage and does not weaken any control. I checked the rest of ci.yml (base lines 1-826) and found nothing else changed. Remaining unverified items: the contents of scripts/test-provider-cluster-runtime-models.py and whether that file exists in the PR. I cannot see it in the supplied evidence. A missing script would fail CI visibly (fail-closed) rather than open a security gap. Any security review of the script's own behavior, such as the runner's use of untrusted fixtures, belongs to a pass that sees that file.
